thesis: The speaker argues that cloning the unusual structural attributes of the Buffett Partnership, such as no management fees and annual reporting, provides a significant competitive advantage because very few funds follow this format. He further contends that non-profits and holding companies should adopt a 'swing for the fences' approach by concentrating resources on one or two causes or investments, a strategy he has implemented in his ventures Daxana and Dhando.
